$comment: CURRENT SHIPPED-COMPONENT REGISTRY. This file records what composable components, blocks, features, and shared patterns exist today; src/component-registry.test.ts enforces bidirectional existence and feature import discipline. Roles/contracts below describe the CURRENT shipped implementation and may be revised or retired by D6/D7 under docs/reference/design-system.md; a registry entry does not make an R4/R5 composition permanent. New global primitives remain registry-first.

AppChrome.role: The global shell: five stable destinations (Trip · Itinerary · Map · Guide · Split), Atlas link, Search field, SOS mount — one DOM at every width (D6-03/05/43)

Block.role: Section dispatcher — routes one guide section to its blocks/ renderer

Contours.role: Full-page survey-contour ground (fixed, decorative); layer data stays per-page

Fold.role: The one collapsible long-explanation pattern (R5 COMPONENTS.md §5)

GapBlock.role: Honest-absence marker — renders a known gap loud, never filler

GuideDestination.role: Guide — cover, chapter overview, one visible chapter level, spatial chapters map-forward, reference objects, knowledge modules (D6-10–13/40/53/54, F6)

Hint.role: '?' affordance holding an explanation until asked

ItineraryDestination.role: Itinerary — day-first on mobile with the thumb-zone day rail; timeline + map workbench on desktop (D6-20/21/49)

MapDestination.role: Map — one real map with the canonical pin sheet/inspector; Google when configured, OSM until then (D6-36/51, F7)

Panel.role: The Atlas container: kicker, title, drag handle, collapse, body

ProvenancePopover.role: Provenance dot + evidence popover (the notation layer)

PwaHead.role: Shared head bits: offline/installable + app icons

ReminderRow.role: One reminder line (print duplicates it outside the panel)

SplitDestination.role: Split — the trip ledger frame around TripSplit (F3)

TransitLinks.role: 'Get me there' — one-tap deep links to a verified coordinate

TripDestination.role: Trip — pre/active/post lifecycle compositions of what matters now, readiness, recap and the Learnings notebook (D6-02/19/30–35/48)

UtilityBar.role: The shared top strip of every non-guide page (intake, progress, triage, change, about, health, 404): wordmark, way back to the Atlas, theme control (§5)

RoutesBlock.role: Transit legs as a journey line

field-tools.role: In-field tools (address card, check-off, day route)

itinerary.role: Itinerary interactions: day rail, desktop workbench divider

mobile-nav.role: Chrome yield on scroll (the five-destination bar itself is AppChrome)

search.role: The one global search: index builder, deterministic ranking, overlay UI

trip.role: Trip lifecycle model (phase, focus, readiness, recap, canonical days) + trip.js

pill.contract: Pressable controls: border-radius 999px, >=44px target, token colours only
pill.note: ~130 per-instance classes; instances are governed by the gates, not enumerated here. Class-level convergence is D7 migration work, not a registry requirement.

card.contract: Content/evidence containers: radius 0, var(--card) ground, var(--rule) hairline

overlay.contract: Full-screen scrims/sheets: rgba(var(--shadow-rgb),alpha) ground; roles today: modal backdrop (~.45), bottom sheet (.6-.75), photo lightbox (.92)
overlay.note: z-index values predate the --z-* scale; retrofit is tracked in base.css's M3 note. Scrim-alpha role tokens are a D6 punch-list candidate.
